defects.scope: local test harness/runtime route; this does not claim a live Stripe outcome

limits: Local synthetic identity and LocalBillingAdapter only; no Stripe account, live provider, remote customer, product, price, charge, or real payment method.

The local checkout completion signs and processes an in-memory fixture through the same server webhook verification and durable billing ledger path; the browser cannot provide plan, customer, organization, or signing secret values.
The local adapter's session registry is process-local and bounded; this demo is a deterministic development fixture, not commercial payment availability.

The production Stripe adapter is deliberately excluded from the local demo route and still requires configured server Price IDs, account onboarding, and webhook setup before live checkout can be offered.
